FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Q2 and who is it for?

Q2 is an integrated sales and marketing automation system built specifically for businesses in the office technology and managed services industry. It combines HubSpot CRM, ZoomInfo data, ConnectAndSell dialing, and Keypoint Intelligence's quote iQ into one unified platform.

How does Q2 compare to using HubSpot alone?

HubSpot alone is a powerful CRM, but Q2 adds industry-specific configurations, pre-built workflows, ZoomInfo data enrichment, ConnectAndSell integration, and a built-in CPQ tool (quote iQ) — all pre-configured for office technology sales processes.

What does Q2 integrate with?

Q2 integrates with EAutomate, CEO Juice, ZoomInfo, ConnectAndSell, ConnectWise, and leasing providers (coming soon). These integrations create a unified view of your entire sales and service operation.

How long does it take to implement Q2?

Our plug-and-play system enables us to set up your portal and train your team in two months or less. The three-phase approach — Systemize, Optimize, Automate — ensures rapid time-to-value.

What results can I expect from Q2?

Clients typically see improved marketing-to-sales alignment, faster deal cycles, higher CRM adoption, and reduced time spent on quoting and admin tasks.
